stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: For your security, please re-enter your password to continue.
setup.title: Set up Gunkly
setup.intro: Create the first account. It will be the administrator of this instance.
setup.codeHint: Find the one-time setup code in the server's container logs (for example with docker logs).
invite.title: You're invited
invite.registerBody: Create an account to join this household.
invite.invalid: This invite link is invalid, expired or already used.
stepUp.emailCodeSent: We emailed a code to your address. Enter it to continue.
signup.intro: Make an account to start tracking your household's chores.
signup.checkEmail: Check your email to finish signing up.
signup.checkEmailHint: If the address can have an account, we sent it a message. Open the link in it, then sign in.
signup.closed: Sign-up is closed on this server. Ask for an invite link.
signup.working: Doing a quick check that you're not a bot…
field.emailOptionalHint: Only needed to reset your password by email.
field.emailHint: We send a link to confirm it.
verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.invalid: This link is not valid any more. It may have been used or may have expired. Sign in and ask for a new one.
verifyEmail.codesIntro: Your account now uses emailed codes as its second step. Save these recovery codes somewhere safe: each works once if you can't get to your email. They won't be shown again.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address or username and we'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account matches, a reset link is on its way. It works once for an hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link is not valid any more. Ask for a new one.
